files.test.yaml:
name: test
template: mcbot
timeout: 60s
setup:
  - forceload add -330 140 -290 165
  - difficulty peaceful
  - fill -315 78 146 -305 78 156 minecraft:grass_block
  - fill -315 79 146 -305 85 156 minecraft:air
  - setblock -311 79 152 minecraft:crafting_table
  - clear {player}
  - item replace entity {player} inventory.7 with minecraft:cobblestone 19
  - item replace entity {player} hotbar.6 with minecraft:cobblestone 3
  - item replace entity {player} inventory.19 with minecraft:stick 5
  - tp {player} -308.5 79 150.5 90 0
skill:
  args: {item: furnace, count: 2}
  timeoutMs: 30000
goal:
  description: Craft at least two furnaces from supplied asymmetric inventory stacks using the reachable crafting table.
  until:
    items: {item: minecraft:furnace, count: 2}
files.skill.md: Craft an item using available ingredients without recursive gathering. args.item is a registry item name; args.count is a positive integer target total inventory count, not a craft count. A crafting table must be reachable within 32 blocks if required. Runtime bindings: bot, mc, goals, goto, sleep, signal. Uses generic recipe discovery and bot.craft for hand recipes. Table recipes use public window clicks and wait boundedly for server-provided output before taking it; recipe output is never fabricated locally. Crafts once at a time, stows cursor items only into known empty inventory slots, closes opened windows even on failure or cancellation, and verifies complete retained inventory progress with an empty cursor. Returns item, final count, and crafts performed. Throws on invalid inputs, missing ingredients/table, full inventory, unsupported recipes, failed progress, navigation/crafting failure, or cancellation. Does not gather prerequisites. Stage revisions separately, preserve failed gate evidence, and promote only explicitly after an independent gate passes.
